strategy.summary: Complete the four lower-right standups and their lane to open the lower re-entry gate, then complete one upper bank for 2x or both for 3x lower-playfield scoring. Lock one ball below and one above, then plunge the Gravity Tunnel to begin the full multiball sequence.

quickInfo.name: Lower re-entry gate
quickInfo.summary: Complete the four lower-right standups and their lane, or either lower bank, to open the gate before committing to the inverted playfield.

quickInfo.name: 2x and 3x lower scoring
quickInfo.summary: Complete either upper drop bank for 2x lower-playfield scoring or both banks for 3x.

quickInfo.name: Lower lock
quickInfo.summary: Hit the lower lock targets, then shoot the lower capture to lock one ball while the re-entry gate is open.

quickInfo.name: Black Hole Multiball
quickInfo.summary: With both locks prepared, plunge through the Gravity Tunnel to begin two-ball play below and then three-ball play above.

quickInfo.name: Gravity Tunnel
quickInfo.summary: The tunnel sends the ball to the inverted lower playfield and should be used only after the gate and scoring state are prepared.

steps.text: Complete the four lower-right standups and their lane to open re-entry, or open it by completing either lower-playfield bank.
Complete either upper drop bank for 2x lower scoring or both banks for 3x.
Lock one ball in the always-active lower capture, then return above through the open re-entry gate.
Complete either upper bank or visit the lower playfield to light the upper lock, then collect it.
Plunge through the Gravity Tunnel to start Black Hole Multiball.
modeNotes: Black Hole Multiball: A qualified ball is locked below and another is locked above. The next ball enters the lower playfield and releases the lower lock for two-ball play.
Three-ball transition: Return through the open lower gate. The upper lock then releases so three balls continue on the main playfield.

steps.text: During lower two-ball play, use controlled Gravity-loop and target shots under 3x. Return through the gate before control breaks.
During upper three-ball play, hit the upper drop-target bank with the safer return. Rebuild the gate before another lower entry.

fallback.title: Controlled Gravity loops
fallback.when: Use this when a lock switch, shared lock, or multiball release is unreliable.

steps.text: Complete the four lower-right standups and their lane to open the lower re-entry gate.
Send one controlled ball through the Gravity Tunnel.
Collect the safest lower-playfield scoring and return through the open gate.
Repeat only after the gate is confirmed open again.

alternatives.title: 3x lower-playfield scoring
alternatives.when: Use this when upper drop banks are safer than the lock sequence.

steps.text: Complete both upper drop banks to light 3x lower scoring.
Complete the four lower-right standups and their lane to open the re-entry gate before entering the lower playfield.
Take controlled lower scoring at 3x, then return through the gate.
Complete the four lower-right standups and their lane to open the lower re-entry gate.
Complete both upper banks for 3x lower scoring.
Lock one ball below and one ball above.
Use the Gravity Tunnel plunge to begin two-ball play below, then return to release the third ball above.

techniques.name: Paired-right-flipper drop catch
techniques.instruction: Drop catch a controlled return on the paired right flippers; do not dead bounce across their gap.

techniques.name: Gravity-loop control
techniques.instruction: Enter the lower playfield only with the re-entry gate open. Use one lower scoring shot, then take the known return before adding another risk.

cautions.issue: A closed lower re-entry gate can trap the ball below and expose the lower drain.
cautions.response: Confirm the gate before every Gravity Tunnel entry. Return above before the gate state changes.

cautions.issue: The paired right flippers have a gap that can defeat a passive dead bounce.
cautions.response: Use an active drop catch or controlled flip. Do not let a fast ball cross the pair without input.

cautions.issue: Locks can be shared or carried between players under some settings.
cautions.response: Check the lock lamps at every ball start. Convert prepared locks before another player can use them when the settings permit stealing.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Gottlieb Black Hole, installed PROM and serial-era hardware, ball count, tilt, replay and Extra Ball conversion, lock sharing, and upper-lock release behavior.
Confirm either upper bank lights 2x below, both light 3x, lower bonus and Bonus X behave as expected, and lock lamps persist correctly.
Test both capture locks, Gravity Tunnel, re-entry gate and switches, inverted flippers, paired upper flippers, lower banks, upper banks, rollunder, and every dangerous return.
strategy.simpleOverview: Black Hole requires an open re-entry gate before the inverted lower playfield is useful. Complete the lower-right standups and lane, prepare 3x with both upper banks, lock one ball below and one above, then plunge the Gravity Tunnel for Multiball.
